profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer at Fidelity Investments, where I work on the chart team building the tools traders use to analyze markets. I own the Profit amp; Loss chart for options trading and build with TypeScript, Angular, and NestJS. Before Fidelity, I worked on network security at AWS (Network Firewall) and interned twice at Amazon. I’m a UT Austin Computer Science graduate, and I care about building scalable, well-tested software that makes complex data easy to act on.

My technical expertise spans full stack development, optimization, and unit testing. I am deeply passionate about creating meaningful and scalable services that enhance user experiences and contribute positively to our digital world.

Away from the mouse and keyboard, you'll often find me embracing the great outdoors and staying active. I am passionate about mma and weightlifting - both are not just workouts for me, but ways to challenge myself mentally on top of being physically strenuous.
